versos.grego: Καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἀναστὰς ἔρχεται εἰς τὰ ὅρια τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, καὶ συνπορεύονται πάλιν ὄχλοι πρὸς αὐτόν, καὶ ὡς εἰώθει πάλιν ἐδίδασκεν αὐτούς.

controles.web: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.
controles.kjv: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
controles.livre: E levantando-se dali, Jesus se foi aos limites da Judeia, por dalém do Jordão; e as multidões voltaram a se juntar a ele, e voltou a lhes ensinar, como tinha costume.

versos.grego: Καὶ προσελθόντες Φαρισαῖοι ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν εἰ ἔξεστιν ἀνδρὶ γυναῖκα ἀπολῦσαι, πειράζοντες αὐτόν.

controles.web: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”
controles.kjv: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
controles.livre: E vindo a ele os fariseus, perguntaram-lhe se era lícito ao homem deixar a sua mulher, testando-o.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τί ὑμῖν ἐνετείλατο Μωϋσῆς;

controles.web: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”
controles.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
controles.livre: Mas ele lhes respondeu: O que Moisés vos mandou?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν· Ἐπέτρεψεν Μωϋσῆς βιβλίον ἀποστασίου γράψαι καὶ ἀπολῦσαι.

controles.web: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”
controles.kjv: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
controles.livre: E eles disseram: Moisés permitiu escrever carta de divórcio, e deixá-la.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πρὸς τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν ὑμῶν ἔγραψεν ὑμῖν τὴν ἐντολὴν ταύτην.

controles.web: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Foi pela dureza dos vossos corações que ele vos escreveu este mandamento.

versos.grego: ἀπὸ δὲ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν αὐτούς·

controles.web: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.
controles.kjv: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
controles.livre: Porém, desde o princípio da criação, macho e fêmea ele os fez.

versos.grego: ἕνεκεν τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν μητέρα,

controles.web: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,
controles.kjv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
controles.livre: Por isso, deixará o homem a seu pai e a sua mãe.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν· ὥστε οὐκέτι εἰσὶν δύο ἀλλὰ μία σάρξ.

controles.web: and the two will become one flesh,so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
controles.kjv: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
controles.livre: E os dois serão uma só carne; assim, já não são dois, mas sim uma só carne.

versos.grego: ὃ οὖν ὁ Θεὸς συνέζευξεν, ἄνθρωπος μὴ χωριζέτω.

controles.web: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”
controles.kjv: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
controles.livre: Portanto, o que Deus juntou, não separe o homem.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν πάλιν οἱ μαθηταὶ περὶ τούτου ἐπηρώτων αὐτόν.

controles.web: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.
controles.kjv: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
controles.livre: E em casa os discípulos voltaram a lhe perguntar sobre isto mesmo.

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ γαμήσῃ ἄλλην, μοιχᾶται ἐπ’ αὐτήν·

controles.web: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery against her.
controles.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Qualquer um que deixar a sua mulher, e se casar com outra, adultera contra ela.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐὰν αὐτὴ ἀπολύσασα τὸν ἄνδρα αὐτῆς γαμήσῃ ἄλλον, μοιχᾶται.

controles.web: If a woman herself divorces her husband, and marries another, she commits adultery.”
controles.kjv: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
controles.livre: E se ela deixar o seu marido, e se casar com outro, adultera.

versos.grego: Καὶ προσέφερον αὐτῷ παιδία ἵνα αὐτῶν ἅψηται· οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμησαν αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.
controles.kjv: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
controles.livre: E lhe traziam crianças para que ele as tocasse, mas os discípulos repreendiam-lhes.

versos.grego: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἠγανάκτησεν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία ἔρχεσθαι πρός με, μὴ κωλύετε αὐτά· τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
controles.kjv: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: Porém Jesus, vendo, indignou-se, e lhe disse: Deixai vir as crianças a mim, e não as impeçais; porque delas é o Reino de Deus.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὃς ἂν μὴ δέξηται τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ ὡς παιδίον, οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτήν.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive the Kingdom of God like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”
controles.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
controles.livre: Em verdade vos digo, que qualquer um que não receber o Reino de Deus como criança, em maneira nenhuma nele entrará.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐναγκαλισάμενος αὐτὰ κατευλόγει τιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ’ αὐτά.

controles.web: He took them in his arms, and blessed them, laying his hands on them.
controles.kjv: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
controles.livre: Então, tomando-as entre seus braços, e pondo as mãos sobre elas, ele as abençoou.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐκπορευομένου αὐτοῦ εἰς ὁδὸν προσδραμὼν εἷς καὶ γονυπετήσας αὐτὸν ἐπηρώτα αὐτόν Διδάσκαλε ἀγαθέ, τί ποιήσω ἵνα ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσω;

controles.web: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”
controles.kjv: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
controles.livre: E quando ele saiu para caminhar, um homem correu até ele; e pondo-se de joelhos diante dele, perguntou-lhe: Bom Mestre, que farei para herdar a vida eterna?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Τί με λέγεις ἀγαθόν; οὐδεὶς ἀγαθὸς εἰ μὴ εἷς ὁ Θεός.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhe disse: Por que me chamas bom? Ninguém é bom, a não ser um: Deus.

versos.grego: τὰς ἐντολὰς οἶδας Μὴ φονεύσῃς, Μὴ μοιχεύσῃς, Μὴ κλέψῃς, Μὴ ψευδομαρτυρήσῃς, Μὴ ἀποστερήσῃς, Τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα.

controles.web: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”
controles.kjv: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
controles.livre: Sabes os mandamentos: Não adulterarás; não matarás; não furtarás; não darás falso testemunho; não serás enganador; honra o teu pai e a tua mãe.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἔφη αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε, ταῦτα πάντα ἐφυλαξάμην ἐκ νεότητός μου.

controles.web: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”
controles.kjv: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
controles.livre: Porém ele lhe respondeu: Mestre, tudo isto guardei desde a minha juventude.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐμβλέψας αὐτῷ ἠγάπησεν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἕν σε ὑστερεῖ· ὕπαγε, ὅσα ἔχεις πώλησον καὶ δὸς τοῖς πτωχοῖς, καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανῷ, καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι.

controles.web: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”
controles.kjv: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
controles.livre: E olhando Jesus para ele, amou-o, e disse-lhe: Uma coisa te falta: vai, vende tudo quanto tens, e dá aos pobres; e terás um tesouro no céu; e vem, segue-me, toma tua cruz.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ στυγνάσας ἐπὶ τῷ λόγῳ ἀπῆλθεν λυπούμενος, ἦν γὰρ ἔχων κτήματα πολλά.

controles.web: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.
controles.kjv: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
controles.livre: Mas ele, pesaroso desta palavra, foi-se triste; porque tinha muitas propriedades.

versos.grego: Καὶ περιβλεψάμενος ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ Πῶς δυσκόλως οἱ τὰ χρήματα ἔχοντες εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσελεύσονται.

controles.web: Jesus looked around, and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!”
controles.kjv: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
controles.livre: Então Jesus olhando ao redor, disse a seus discípulos: Como é difícil aos que têm riquezas entrar no Reino de Deus!

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐθαμβοῦντο ἐπὶ τοῖς λόγοις αὐτοῦ. ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν ἀποκριθεὶς λέγει αὐτοῖς Τέκνα, πῶς δύσκολόν ἐστιν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσελθεῖν·

controles.web: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard is it for those who trust in riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!
controles.kjv: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
controles.livre: E os discípulos se espantaram destas suas palavras; mas Jesus, voltando a responder, disse-lhes: Filhos, como é difícil  entrar no Reino de Deus!

versos.grego: εὐκοπώτερόν ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τῆς τρυμαλιᾶς τῆς ῥαφίδος διελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰσελθεῖν.

controles.web: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.”
controles.kjv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: Mais fácil é passar um camelo pelo olho de uma agulha, do que entrar um rico no Reino de Deus.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ περισσῶς ἐξεπλήσσοντο λέγοντες πρὸς ἑαυτούς Καὶ τίς δύναται σωθῆναι;

controles.web: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”
controles.kjv: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
controles.livre: E eles se espantavam ainda mais, dizendo uns para os outros: Quem, pois, poderá se salvar?

versos.grego: ἐμβλέψας αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει Παρὰ ἀνθρώποις ἀδύνατον, ἀλλ’ οὐ παρὰ θεῷ· πάντα γὰρ δυνατὰ παρὰ τῷ θεῷ.

controles.web: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
controles.livre: Porém, olhando Jesus para eles, disse: Para os seres humanos, é impossível; mas para Deus, não; porque para Deus tudo é possível.

versos.grego: Ἤρξατο λέγειν ὁ Πέτρος αὐτῷ Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν πάντα καὶ ἠκολουθήκαμέν σοι.

controles.web: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all, and have followed you.”
controles.kjv: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
controles.livre: E Pedro começou a lhe dizer: Eis que nós deixamos tudo, e te seguimos.

versos.grego: ἔφη ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, οὐδείς ἐστιν ὃς ἀφῆκεν οἰκίαν ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ ἀδελφὰς ἢ μητέρα ἢ πατέρα ἢ τέκνα ἢ ἀγροὺς ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ καὶ ἕνεκεν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,

controles.web: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel’s,
controles.livre: Jesus respondeu: Em verdade vos digo, que não há ninguém que tenha deixado casa, ou irmãos, ou irmãs, ou mãe, ou pai, ou filhos, ou campos, por amor de mim e do Evangelho,

versos.grego: ἐὰν μὴ λάβῃ ἑκατονταπλασίονα νῦν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τούτῳ οἰκίας καὶ ἀδελφοὺς καὶ ἀδελφὰς καὶ μητέρας καὶ τέκνα καὶ ἀγροὺς μετὰ διωγμῶν, καὶ ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τῷ ἐρχομένῳ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

controles.web: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time, houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.
controles.kjv: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
controles.livre: que não receba cem vezes tanto, agora neste tempo, casas, e irmãos, e irmãs, e mães, e filhos, e campos, com perseguições; e a vida eterna, no tempo que virá.

versos.grego: πολλοὶ δὲ ἔσονται πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι καὶ οἱ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι.

controles.web: But many who are first will be last; and the last first.”
controles.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
controles.livre: Porém muitos primeiros serão últimos, e últimos, primeiros.

versos.grego: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἀναβαίνοντες εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, καὶ ἦν προάγων αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐθαμβοῦντο, οἱ δὲ ἀκολουθοῦντες ἐφοβοῦντο. καὶ παραλαβὼν πάλιν τοὺς δώδεκα ἤρξατο αὐτοῖς λέγειν τὰ μέλλοντα αὐτῷ συμβαίνειν,

controles.web: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.
controles.kjv: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
controles.livre: E iam pelo caminho, subindo para Jerusalém; e Jesus ia diante deles, e espantavam-se, e seguiam-no atemorizados. E voltando a tomar consigo aos doze, começou-lhes a dizer as coisas que lhe viriam a acontecer:

versos.grego: ὅτι Ἰδοὺ ἀναβαίνομεν εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδοθήσεται τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς γραμματεῦσιν, καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτὸν θανάτῳ καὶ παραδώσουσιν αὐτὸν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν

controles.web: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.
controles.kjv: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
controles.livre: Eis que subimos a Jerusalém, e o Filho do homem será entregue aos chefes dos sacerdotes, e aos escribas; e o condenarão à morte, e o entregarão aos gentios.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐμπαίξουσιν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐμπτύσουσιν αὐτῷ καὶ μαστιγώσουσιν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσιν, καὶ μετὰ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ἀναστήσεται.

controles.web: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”
controles.kjv: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
controles.livre: E escarnecerão dele, e cuspirão nele, e o açoitarão, e o matarão; e três dias depois ressuscitará.

versos.grego: Καὶ προσπορεύονται αὐτῷ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωάνης οἱ υἱοὶ Ζεβεδαίου λέγοντες αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε, θέλομεν ἵνα ὃ ἐὰν αἰτήσωμέν σε ποιήσῃς ἡμῖν.

controles.web: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”
controles.kjv: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
controles.livre: E vieram a ele Tiago e João, filhos de Zebedeu, dizendo-lhe: Mestre, queríamos que nos fizesses o que pedirmos.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τί θέλετε με ποιήσω ὑμῖν;

controles.web: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: O que quereis que eu vos faça?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Δὸς ἡμῖν ἵνα εἷς σου ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ εἷς ἐξ ἀριστερῶν καθίσωμεν ἐν τῇ δόξῃ σου.

controles.web: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand, and one at your left hand, in your glory.”
controles.kjv: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
controles.livre: E eles lhe disseram: Concede-nos que em tua glória nos sentemos, um à tua direita, e outro à tua esquerda?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οὐκ οἴδατε τί αἰτεῖσθε. δύνασθε πιεῖν τὸ ποτήριον ὃ ἐγὼ πίνω, ἢ τὸ βάπτισμα ὃ ἐγὼ βαπτίζομαι βαπτισθῆναι;

controles.web: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
controles.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
controles.livre: Mas Jesus lhes disse: Não sabeis o que pedis; podeis vós beber o copo que eu bebo, ou ser batizados com o batismo com que eu sou batizado?

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Δυνάμεθα. ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τὸ ποτήριον ὃ ἐγὼ πίνω πίεσθε, καὶ τὸ βάπτισμα ὃ ἐγὼ βαπτίζομαι βαπτισθήσεσθε·

controles.web: They said to him, “We are able.”   Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;
controles.kjv: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
controles.livre: E eles lhe disseram: Podemos. Porém Jesus lhes disse: Em verdade, o copo que eu bebo, bebereis; e com o batismo com que eu sou batizado, sereis batizados.

versos.grego: τὸ δὲ καθίσαι ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἢ ἐξ εὐωνύμων οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὸν δοῦναι, ἀλλ’ οἷς ἡτοίμασται.

controles.web: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”
controles.kjv: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
controles.livre: Mas sentar-se à minha direita, ou à minha esquerda, não é meu concedê-lo, mas sim, para aqueles a quem está preparado.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἀκούσαντες οἱ δέκα ἤρξαντο ἀγανακτεῖν περὶ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάνου.

controles.web: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant towards James and John.
controles.kjv: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
controles.livre: E quando os dez ouviram isto, começaram a se irritar contra Tiago e João.

versos.grego: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτοὺς ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς Οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ δοκοῦντες ἄρχειν τῶν ἐθνῶν κατακυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ μεγάλοι αὐτῶν κατεξουσιάζουσιν αὐτῶν.

controles.web: Jesus summoned them, and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.
controles.kjv: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
controles.livre: Mas Jesus, chamando-os a si, disse-lhes: Já sabeis que os que são vistos como governadores dos gentios, agem como senhores deles; e os grandes usam de autoridade sobre eles.

versos.grego: οὐχ οὕτως δέ ἐστιν ἐν ὑμῖν· ἀλλ’ ὃς ἂν θέλῃ μέγας γενέσθαι ἐν ὑμῖν, ἔσται ὑμῶν διάκονος,

controles.web: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.
controles.kjv: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
controles.livre: Mas entre vós não será assim; antes qualquer que entre vós quiser ser grande, será vosso servidor.

versos.grego: καὶ ὃς ἂν θέλῃ ἐν ὑμῖν εἶναι πρῶτος, ἔσται πάντων δοῦλος·

controles.web: Whoever of you wants to become first among you, shall be bondservant of all.
controles.kjv: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
controles.livre: E qualquer que de vós quiser ser o primeiro, será servo de todos.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἦλθεν διακονηθῆναι ἀλλὰ διακονῆσαι καὶ δοῦναι τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ λύτρον ἀντὶ πολλῶν.

controles.web: For the Son of Man also came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
controles.kjv: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
controles.livre: Porque também não veio o Filho do homem para ser servido, mas para servir, e dar sua vida em resgate por muitos.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἔρχονται εἰς Ἰερειχώ. Καὶ ἐκπορευομένου αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ Ἰερειχὼ καὶ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ὄχλου ἱκανοῦ ὁ υἱὸς Τιμαίου Βαρτιμαῖος, τυφλὸς προσαίτης, ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν ὁδόν.

controles.web: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.
controles.kjv: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimeus, the son of Timeus, sat by the highway side begging.
controles.livre: E vieram a Jericó. E saindo ele, e seus discípulos, e uma grande multidão de Jericó, estava Bartimeu, um mendigo cego, filho de Timeu, sentado junto ao caminho.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀκούσας ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζαρηνός ἐστιν ἤρξατο κράζειν καὶ λέγειν Υἱὲ Δαυεὶδ Ἰησοῦ, ἐλέησόν με.

controles.web: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out, and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”
controles.kjv: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
controles.livre: E ouvindo que era Jesus o nazareno, começou a clamar, e a dizer: Jesus, Filho de Davi! Tem misericórdia de mim!

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπετίμων αὐτῷ πολλοὶ ἵνα σιωπήσῃ· ὁ δὲ πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἔκραζεν Υἱὲ Δαυείδ, ἐλέησόν με.

controles.web: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”
controles.kjv: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
controles.livre: E muitos o repreendiam, para que se calasse; mas ele clamava ainda mais: Filho de Davi! Tem misericórdia de mim!

versos.grego: καὶ στὰς ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Φωνήσατε αὐτόν. καὶ φωνοῦσιν τὸν τυφλὸν λέγοντες αὐτῷ Θάρσει, ἔγειρε, φωνεῖ σε.

controles.web: Jesus stood still, and said, “Call him.”   They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”
controles.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
controles.livre: Jesus parou, e disse:chamai-o. Então chamaram ao cego, dizendo-lhe: Tem bom ânimo, levanta-te, ele está te chamando.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποβαλὼν τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ ἀναπηδήσας ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.
controles.kjv: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
controles.livre: Então ele lançou sua capa, deu um salto, e veio a Jesus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Τί σοι θέλεις ποιήσω; ὁ δὲ τυφλὸς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ῥαββουνεί, ἵνα ἀναβλέψω.

controles.web: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?”   The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
controles.livre: Jesus, lhe perguntou: Que queres que eu te faça? E o cego lhe disse: Mestre, que eu veja.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ὕπαγε, ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε. καὶ εὐθὺς ἀνέβλεψεν, καὶ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.”  Immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus on the way.
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
controles.livre: Jesus lhe disse: Vai; a tua fé te salvou. E logo consegiu ver. Então seguiu Jesus  pelo caminho.
